description: This file defines the FP_eventsDashlet class, which extends DashletGeneric, used to create a configurable dashboard widget for FP_events in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes initialization logic, references external dashlet view definitions, and sets up search fields and columns for the dashlet.

classes.name: FP_eventsDashlet
classes.description: A class extending DashletGeneric, representing a dashboard widget for FP_events with custom title, search fields, columns, and seed bean setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet with its ID, definitions, title, search fields, columns, and seed bean based on FP_events.
